slice: Beta RX 300 and RX 450 2025 KYB settings (2026-11)

records.topic: KYB fork and shock settings: factory, racing, comfort and soft
records.statement: Beta's published KYB settings for the 2025 RX 300, all counted out from fully in. Fork compression: 12 clicks factory, 10 racing, 14 comfort, 16 soft. Fork rebound: 11 clicks factory, 12 racing, 14 comfort, 16 soft. Shock low-speed compression: 14 clicks factory, 8 racing, 12 comfort, 16 soft. Shock high-speed compression: 1.5 turns factory, 1.25 racing, 1.5 comfort, 1.75 soft. Shock rebound: 14 clicks factory, 12 racing, 14 comfort, 16 soft. Fork oil volume on the chart is 300 cc. Sag ranges: 95 to 110 mm rider sag and 25 to 45 mm static sag.

source.name: Beta USA 2025 KYB fork and shock suspension settings list

records.notes: Recorded from Beta USA's settings list in a workbook the owner supplied; confirm against the sheet before relying on a click count.
